title: Golf Story
subtitle: An adventure played with a golf club
summary: Golf Story is Sidebar Games' golfing role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 28 September 2017.
body: Golf Story is Sidebar Games' golfing role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 28 September 2017. A golfer returns to the sport he loved as a child and attempts to build a career among the courses and communities surrounding it. Matches sit within a larger world of conversations, odd jobs and comic disputes. The club is useful beyond a formal round, allowing the player to take shots around the landscape and discover how golf can become the means of completing an adventure.

A three-click system determines the direction, power and accuracy of a shot. Club choice, distance and the ground around the ball affect the approach to each hole. Between rounds, challenges provide money and experience that improve the golfer's abilities and equipment. Because shots can be played outside the courses, an obstacle or request in the surrounding world may be answered with the same action used on the fairway. Learning the sport also expands what the player can accomplish while exploring.

Eight areas provide courses, side activities and characters whose problems give the next match a personal context. Disc golf, miniature golf and other variations change the scale or equipment while retaining the pleasure of judging a trajectory. Joel Steudler composed the music. The Game Boy Color Mario Golf helped inspire Sidebar's approach, but Golf Story builds its own comic community around the sport. Progress means improving a score and gradually finding a place among the people who care, argue or obsess about the game.
